title: T4 Replace four page-level text resets with one icon control
description: Add one server-safe accessible RotateCcw reset link and use it on Models, Compare, Providers, and Sources without conflating filter reset and column reset.
action: Create components/reset-filter-link.tsx as a server-safe Link using lucide-react RotateCcw, the existing icon-button class, localized reset aria-label/title, and aria-hidden icon. Replace exactly four page-level text reset links; leave ColumnPicker reset-columns unchanged.
implementation: Models and Compare reset hrefs drop filter/search/sort/order/page while retaining active cols including none; Providers and Sources continue to target /providers and /sources.
Compare reset removes explicit sort=none or another sort so default AAIndex descending resumes without clearing its column preference.
After implementation, add four-page navigation assertions and keyboard, localized name/title, mobile target-size, and axe browser evidence.
convergence_criteria: [UI-observable] Exactly four page toolbar resets share ResetFilterLink, RotateCcw, icon-button, localized aria-label, and title.
Models and Compare reset to page 1/default filters and sorting while retaining cols including none; Compare resumes AAIndex descending.
Providers and Sources navigate to their unfiltered roots.
Each reset is keyboard-operable, is at least 44px under coarse pointer, and produces 0 serious or critical axe violations.
